g.text: Where rising can change the contact

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526577

g.text: Current v3 nominal geometry • long screw + virtual footless 50-mm pin • all dimensions in mm

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526577

g.text: Owner: long screw, approximately 15-mm rise; exact pin length and later knife cuts are not reconstructed.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243746

g.text: Same 48-mm screw; the lower 6-mm pin thread remains engaged in both poses.
Guide overlap decreases as the pin rises. A larger tip lever arm, bow or axis error
can nevertheless increase side reactions and cause binding.
Axial positions are proportional; transverse widths are enlarged for legibility.
Frame exterior, PCB, wires and bands omitted. This is not an assembly drawing.
Journal Ø7.4 around rotor Ø7 → 0.20 radial gap.
Upward reaction: shoulder → upper stop after float is taken up.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243746

g.text: These clearances are not measured print tolerances.
Closing pressure can alter real alignment and contact.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243746

g.text: The source pin STL has a 12 × 12 × 0.24 print foot. If retained, it
hits the guide after +4.56 mm from this low datum. The owner
reports artifact removal; this is not the leading cause of the
reported 15-mm run. No additional cutting is prescribed.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526577

g.text: Digital contact schematic • 23 October 2026 • Existing-parts isolation test; no new print and no claim of proven low friction.
